---
agent: 'agent'
description: "Compute the next workflow step and tell which command, mode and model to use (minimal cost)"
model: "Claude Haiku 5.5"
---
<!-- Generated by tools/render_agents.py from workflow/workflow.toml and models.toml — do not edit; run `make agents`. -->
Arguments ([ID]  (optional: state of one story)): ${input:args}

Do not explore the repository: the state is computed by the script.

1. Run `python3 tools/next_step.py the arguments above`.
2. Read only `workflow/steps/<recommended step>.md` (and the optional parallel step's file, if any). Nothing else.
3. Answer in at most 10 lines:

```
State: <phase / current sprint, 1 line>
Next: <step> — <IDs>
Who: <mode | YOU (human gate)>  ·  Tier: <tier> → <model printed by the script>
Why: <1 line>
Run: <fresh session> → <exact command with IDs>     (or: "human action: …")
In parallel (optional): <command>
Waiting on you: <human gates, if any>
```

4. Do not execute the step in this session. If the weekly reminder is printed, add one line with `/weekly`.
